[汇总]checkpoint恢复阶段全参数cksum/shape/dtype完整.description: 在model-after-checkpoint-restore阶段，检查所有参数（包括常规参数、shared_experts、layernorm、router、tied_weights等）在所有并行维度（DP/TP/PP/SP/EP）下的数值（cksum/hash）、shape和dtype与保存时是否完全一致。若发现任一参数的cksum、shape或dtype不一致，表明模型已损坏或恢复过程存在隐蔽错误，需立即中止训练并报警。

[汇总]checkpoint阶段optimizer state分片完整性与一致性.description: 在checkpoint阶段，检查所有分片rank的optimizer state（如momentum、variance等）快照的完整性与一致性。若发现有分片丢失、损坏或内容不一致，表明checkpoint恢复后训练将异常或发散，需及时修复。

forward/backward阶段pipeline_parallel激活张量P.name: forward/backward阶段pipeline_parallel激活张量P2P通信前后数值分布健康性检查

variants.sql: WITH param_stats AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) as pp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) as tp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) as dp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') as cksum, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE (stage LIKE 'model-after-forward-mbs-%' OR stage = 'model-after-backward') AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) > 1 AND json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') IS NOT NULL), partition_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, stage, pp_rank, tp_rank, dp_rank, cksum, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, stage, tp_rank, dp_rank) as records_per_partition, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, stage, tp_rank, dp_rank ORDER BY pp_rank) as rn FROM param_stats), inconsistency_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, stage, tp_rank, dp_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT cksum) as distinct_cksums, COUNT(*) as total_records, array_agg(DISTINCT cksum) as all_cksums, array_agg(DISTINCT pp_rank) as pp_ranks FROM param_stats GROUP BY param_name, step, stage, tp_rank, dp_rank HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cksum) > 1) SELECT * FROM inconsistency_check ORDER BY step, stage, param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank

forward/backward阶段pipeline_parallel激活张量物.description: 在forward或backward阶段，pipeline_parallel_size>=2且micro_batch_size>1时，检查同一rank上所有pipeline stage的激活张量buffer在P2P通信完成后物理内存地址互不重叠。若发现重叠，表明存在buffer覆盖风险，可能导致数据污染或训练异常。

variants.sql: WITH relevant_records AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) as pp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) as dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) as tp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') as cksum, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE (stage LIKE 'forward' OR stage LIKE 'backward') AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) >= 2 AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.micro_batch_size') AS INTEGER) > 1), overlap_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, stage, pp_rank, dp_rank, tp_rank, cksum, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, stage, pp_rank, dp_rank, tp_rank) as same_cksum_count, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, stage, pp_rank, dp_rank, tp_rank, cksum) as cksum_count FROM relevant_records) SELECT DISTINCT param_name, step, stage, pp_rank, dp_rank, tp_rank, cksum, same_cksum_count, cksum_count FROM overlap_check WHERE same_cksum_count > 1 AND cksum_count > 1 ORDER BY step, stage, param_name, pp_rank, dp_rank, tp_rank

WITH param_data AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) as pp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) as dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) as tp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') as cksum, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE (stage LIKE '%forward%' OR stage LIKE '%backward%') AND json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') IS NOT NULL), overlap_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, stage, COUNT(DISTINCT cksum) as distinct_cksums, COUNT(*) as total_records, array_agg(DISTINCT cksum) as all_cksums, array_agg(DISTINCT pp_rank) as pp_ranks, array_agg(DISTINCT dp_rank) as dp_ranks, array_agg(DISTINCT tp_rank) as tp_ranks FROM param_data GROUP BY param_name, step, stage HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cksum) < COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT cksum) > 0) SELECT * FROM overlap_check ORDER BY step, stage, param_name

forward/backward阶段pipeline_parallel边界mic.name: forward/backward阶段pipeline_parallel边界micro-batch激活张量数值分布统计一致性检查
forward/backward阶段pipeline_parallel边界mic.description: 在forward和backward阶段，检查pipeline_parallel各stage边界micro-batch激活张量在P2P通信后的数值分布（均值、方差、极值）。若激活张量出现全零、全NaN、全Inf或均值/方差/极值超出合理范围（如绝对值>1e6或<1e-6），则判定为数值异常，提示silent failure或数值爆炸/消失。该约束用于补充检测shape/dtype一致性和cksum完整性无法发现的激活异常。

variants.sql: WITH activation_stats AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') AS param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) AS pp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.step') AS INTEGER) AS step, json_extract_string(data, '$.stage') AS stage, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.mean') AS DOUBLE) AS mean_val, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.variance') AS DOUBLE) AS var_val, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.min') AS DOUBLE) AS min_val, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.max') AS DOUBLE) AS max_val FROM coredump WHERE json_extract_string(data, '$.stage') IN ('forward', 'backward') AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) >= 2 AND json_extract(data, '$.mean') IS NOT NULL), anomaly_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, stage, pp_rank, mean_val, var_val, min_val, max_val, CASE WHEN mean_val = 0 AND var_val = 0 AND min_val = 0 AND max_val = 0 THEN 'all_zero' WHEN mean_val IS NULL OR var_val IS NULL OR min_val IS NULL OR max_val IS NULL THEN 'null_values' WHEN mean_val != mean_val OR var_val != var_val OR min_val != min_val OR max_val != max_val THEN 'nan_values' WHEN ABS(mean_val) > 1000000.0 OR ABS(var_val) > 1000000.0 OR ABS(min_val) > 1000000.0 OR ABS(max_val) > 1000000.0 THEN 'value_explosion' WHEN ABS(mean_val) < 1e-6 AND ABS(var_val) < 1e-6 AND ABS(min_val) < 1e-6 AND ABS(max_val) < 1e-6 THEN 'value_disappearance' ELSE 'normal' END AS anomaly_type FROM activation_stats) SELECT param_name, step, stage, pp_rank, mean_val, var_val, min_val, max_val, anomaly_type FROM anomaly_check WHERE anomaly_type != 'normal' ORDER BY step, stage, pp_rank, param_name

variants.sql: WITH param_info AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') AS param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) AS tp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) AS dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) AS pp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') AS cksum, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_cksum') AS grad_cksum, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_shape') AS grad_shape, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_type') AS grad_type, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') AS BOOLEAN) AS requires_grad, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.valid') AS BOOLEAN) AS valid FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'model-after-backward' AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') AS BOOLEAN) = true), anomaly_check AS (SELECT param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank, cksum, grad_cksum, grad_shape, grad_type, CASE WHEN grad_cksum IS NULL THEN 'missing_main_grad' WHEN grad_shape IS NULL OR grad_type IS NULL THEN 'incomplete_grad_metadata' ELSE 'ok' END AS anomaly_type FROM param_info WHERE grad_cksum IS NULL OR grad_shape IS NULL OR grad_type IS NULL) SELECT param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank, cksum, grad_cksum, grad_shape, grad_type, anomaly_type FROM anomaly_check WHERE anomaly_type != 'ok' ORDER BY param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank

WITH param_info AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') AS param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) AS tp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) AS dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) AS pp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') AS cksum, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') AS BOOLEAN) AS requires_grad, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_cksum') AS grad_cksum, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_shape') AS grad_shape, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_type') AS grad_type, json_extract_string(data, '$.shape') AS shape, json_extract_string(data, '$.type') AS type FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'model-after-backward' AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) > 1), grad_check AS (SELECT param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank, requires_grad, cksum, grad_cksum, grad_shape, grad_type, shape, type, CASE WHEN requires_grad = true AND (grad_cksum IS NULL OR grad_shape IS NULL OR grad_type IS NULL) THEN 'missing_grad' WHEN requires_grad = true AND (grad_shape != shape OR grad_type != type) THEN 'grad_mismatch' ELSE 'ok' END AS status FROM param_info) SELECT param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank, shape, type, grad_shape, grad_type, status, COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM grad_check WHERE status != 'ok' GROUP BY param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank, shape, type, grad_shape, grad_type, status ORDER BY param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank

model-after-backward阶段TP分片梯度分布差异性检查.name: model-after-backward阶段TP分片梯度分布差异性检查
model-after-backward阶段TP分片梯度分布差异性检查.description: 在model-after-backward阶段，检查所有tensor parallel组内可训练参数的grad分片在不同TP rank上是否具有显著分布差异。若绝大多数参数的梯度分片完全一致（无论为0或非0），表明存在分片同步、通信或分片逻辑异常，训练可能退化为数据并行。允许个别参数（如未参与前向/反向传播的参数或显式共享参数）梯度完全一致，但大范围一致为异常。

variants.sql: WITH param_grads AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) as tp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_cksum') as grad_cksum, step FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'model-after-backward' AND json_extract(data, '$.tp') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') = true AND json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_cksum') IS NOT NULL), tp_group_stats AS (SELECT param_name, step, tp_rank, grad_cksum FROM param_grads), consistency_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, COUNT(DISTINCT grad_cksum) as distinct_grad_cksums, COUNT(*) as total_tp_ranks, array_agg(DISTINCT grad_cksum) as all_grad_cksums, array_agg(DISTINCT tp_rank) as tp_ranks FROM tp_group_stats GROUP BY param_name, step HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT grad_cksum) = 1 AND COUNT(*) > 1), anomaly_summary AS (SELECT step, COUNT(*) as consistent_param_count, array_agg(param_name) as consistent_params FROM consistency_check GROUP BY step HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT * FROM anomaly_summary ORDER BY step

WITH param_grad_stats AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) as tp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) as dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) as pp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_cksum') as grad_cksum, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'model-after-backward' AND json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_cksum') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract_string(data, '$.requires_grad') = true), tp_group_stats AS (SELECT param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT tp_rank) as total_tp_ranks, COUNT(DISTINCT grad_cksum) as distinct_grad_cksums, array_agg(DISTINCT tp_rank ORDER BY tp_rank) as tp_ranks, array_agg(DISTINCT grad_cksum) as all_grad_cksums FROM param_grad_stats GROUP BY param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank), consistent_params AS (SELECT param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank, total_tp_ranks, distinct_grad_cksums, tp_ranks, all_grad_cksums FROM tp_group_stats WHERE distinct_grad_cksums = 1 AND total_tp_ranks > 1), anomaly_summary AS (SELECT step, dp_rank, pp_rank, COUNT(*) as consistent_param_count, array_agg(param_name) as consistent_param_names FROM consistent_params GROUP BY step, dp_rank, pp_rank HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT * FROM anomaly_summary ORDER BY step, dp_rank, pp_rank

WITH grad_stats AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) as tp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) as dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) as pp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_cksum') as grad_cksum, step FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'model-after-backward' AND json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_cksum') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') = true), tp_group_consistency AS (SELECT param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT grad_cksum) as distinct_grad_cksums, COUNT(*) as total_records, array_agg(DISTINCT tp_rank) as tp_ranks, array_agg(DISTINCT grad_cksum) as all_grad_cksums FROM grad_stats GROUP BY param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT grad_cksum) = 1 AND COUNT(*) > 1), anomaly_summary AS (SELECT param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank, distinct_grad_cksums, total_records, tp_ranks, all_grad_cksums FROM tp_group_consistency) SELECT * FROM anomaly_summary ORDER BY step, param_name, dp_rank, pp_rank

model-after-backward阶段TP梯度shape和dtype一致性.name: model-after-backward阶段TP梯度shape和dtype一致性检查
model-after-backward阶段TP梯度shape和dtype一致性.description: 在model-after-backward阶段，检查所有tensor parallel组内分片参数的梯度shape和dtype与其参数分片严格一致，且在同一tensor parallel组内所有rank上均满足该属性一致性。若发现shape或dtype不一致，表明存在同步异常或潜在的通信错误/数据损坏。

variants.sql: WITH param_info AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') AS param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) AS tp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) AS dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) AS pp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_shape') AS grad_shape, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_type') AS grad_type, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'model-after-backward' AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) > 1 AND json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_shape') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_type') IS NOT NULL), shape_dtype_consistency AS (SELECT param_name, step, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank, grad_shape, grad_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, tp_rank) AS group_count, MIN(grad_shape) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, tp_rank) AS min_shape, MAX(grad_shape) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, tp_rank) AS max_shape, MIN(grad_type) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, tp_rank) AS min_type, MAX(grad_type) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, tp_rank) AS max_type FROM param_info), inconsistency_check AS (SELECT DISTINCT param_name, step, tp_rank, array_agg(DISTINCT dp_rank) AS dp_ranks, array_agg(DISTINCT pp_rank) AS pp_ranks, array_agg(DISTINCT grad_shape) AS grad_shapes, array_agg(DISTINCT grad_type) AS grad_types, COUNT(DISTINCT grad_shape) AS distinct_shapes, COUNT(DISTINCT grad_type) AS distinct_types FROM param_info GROUP BY param_name, step, tp_rank HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT grad_shape) > 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT grad_type) > 1) SELECT * FROM inconsistency_check ORDER BY step, param_name, tp_rank

WITH param_info AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') AS param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) AS tp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) AS dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) AS pp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_shape') AS grad_shape, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_type') AS grad_type, json_extract_string(data, '$.shape') AS shape, json_extract_string(data, '$.type') AS type, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'model-after-backward' AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) > 1 AND json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_shape') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_type') IS NOT NULL), shape_dtype_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank, grad_shape, grad_type, shape, type, CASE WHEN grad_shape != shape OR grad_type != type THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mismatch_flag FROM param_info), inconsistency_summary AS (SELECT param_name, step, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mismatch_flag = 1 THEN tp_rank END) AS tp_ranks_with_mismatch, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mismatch_flag = 1 THEN dp_rank || '_' || pp_rank END) AS dp_pp_combos_with_mismatch, COUNT(*) AS total_records, SUM(mismatch_flag) AS total_mismatches, array_agg(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mismatch_flag = 1 THEN tp_rank END) AS mismatched_tp_ranks, array_agg(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mismatch_flag = 1 THEN dp_rank || '_' || pp_rank END) AS mismatched_dp_pp_combos FROM shape_dtype_check GROUP BY param_name, step HAVING SUM(mismatch_flag) > 0) SELECT * FROM inconsistency_summary ORDER BY step, param_name

WITH param_grad_info AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) as tp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) as dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) as pp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_shape') as grad_shape, json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_type') as grad_type, json_extract_string(data, '$.shape') as param_shape, json_extract_string(data, '$.type') as param_type FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'model-after-backward' AND json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_shape') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract_string(data, '$.grad_type') IS NOT NULL), tp_group_shape_check AS (SELECT param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank, grad_shape, param_shape, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank) as records_in_group FROM param_grad_info WHERE grad_shape != param_shape), tp_group_dtype_check AS (SELECT param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank, grad_type, param_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank) as records_in_group FROM param_grad_info WHERE grad_type != param_type), inconsistency_summary AS (SELECT 'shape_mismatch' as check_type, param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank, grad_shape as actual_value, param_shape as expected_value, records_in_group FROM tp_group_shape_check UNION ALL SELECT 'dtype_mismatch' as check_type, param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank, grad_type as actual_value, param_type as expected_value, records_in_group FROM tp_group_dtype_check) SELECT * FROM inconsistency_summary ORDER BY check_type, param_name, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank

variants.sql: WITH param_data AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') AS param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) AS tp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) AS dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) AS pp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.shape') AS shape_str, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.size') AS BIGINT) AS size, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') AS cksum, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'model-after-optimizer-step' AND json_extract_string(data, '$.name') LIKE '%attention.dense.weight' AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) > 1), tp_groups AS (SELECT param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT tp_rank) AS num_tp_shards, array_agg(DISTINCT tp_rank ORDER BY tp_rank) AS tp_ranks, array_agg(DISTINCT shape_str ORDER BY tp_rank) AS shapes, array_agg(DISTINCT size ORDER BY tp_rank) AS sizes, array_agg(DISTINCT cksum ORDER BY tp_rank) AS cksums FROM param_data GROUP BY param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank), shape_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank, num_tp_shards, tp_ranks, shapes, sizes, cksums, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s) FROM (SELECT unnest(shapes) AS s) AS t) > 1 THEN 'shape_inconsistent' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s) FROM (SELECT unnest(sizes) AS s) AS t) > 1 THEN 'size_inconsistent' ELSE 'consistent' END AS status FROM tp_groups) SELECT param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank, num_tp_shards, tp_ranks, shapes, sizes, cksums, status FROM shape_check WHERE status != 'consistent' ORDER BY step, param_name, dp_rank, pp_rank

WITH target_params AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) as tp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) as dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) as pp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.shape') as shape_str, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'model-after-optimizer-step' AND json_extract_string(data, '$.name') LIKE '%attention.dense.weight' AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) > 1), shape_analysis AS (SELECT param_name, step, tp_rank, dp_rank, pp_rank, shape_str, CAST(json_extract_string(data, '$.shape[0]') AS INTEGER) as shape_dim0, CAST(json_extract_string(data, '$.shape[1]') AS INTEGER) as shape_dim1 FROM target_params), tp_group_stats AS (SELECT param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT tp_rank) as tp_count, COUNT(DISTINCT shape_str) as distinct_shapes, array_agg(DISTINCT shape_str) as all_shapes, array_agg(DISTINCT tp_rank) as tp_ranks, MIN(shape_dim0) as min_dim0, MAX(shape_dim0) as max_dim0, MIN(shape_dim1) as min_dim1, MAX(shape_dim1) as max_dim1 FROM shape_analysis GROUP BY param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT shape_str) > 1 OR (COUNT(DISTINCT tp_rank) > 1 AND (MIN(shape_dim0) != MAX(shape_dim0) OR MIN(shape_dim1) != MAX(shape_dim1)))) SELECT * FROM tp_group_stats ORDER BY step, param_name, dp_rank, pp_rank

optimizer-step阶段pipeline parallel分区边界结构性.description: 在optimizer-step阶段，检查所有pipeline parallel stage的参数分区边界（shape、数量、顺序）与模型初始化时的分区方案是否严格一致。若分区结构发生漂移或参数顺序错乱，即使参数内容本身一致，也会导致optimizer state错位和silent parameter update error，训练结果不可复现。该约束适用于pipeline_parallel度大于1的所有训练过程，尤其在checkpoint恢复、热启动、pipeline stage数量调整等场景下，必须保证分区结构不变。

variants.sql: WITH optimizer_states AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') AS param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) AS pp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') AS cksum, step FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'optimizer-step' AND json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') IS NOT NULL AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) >= 0), boundary_check AS (SELECT a.param_name, a.step, a.pp_rank AS pp_rank_a, b.pp_rank AS pp_rank_b, a.cksum AS cksum_a, b.cksum AS cksum_b FROM optimizer_states a JOIN optimizer_states b ON a.param_name = b.param_name AND a.step = b.step AND a.pp_rank = b.pp_rank - 1 WHERE a.cksum != b.cksum) SELECT param_name, step, pp_rank_a, pp_rank_b, cksum_a, cksum_b FROM boundary_check ORDER BY step, param_name, pp_rank_a

WITH optimizer_states AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') AS param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) AS pp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) AS dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) AS tp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') AS cksum, step FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'optimizer-step' AND json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') IS NOT NULL), boundary_pairs AS (SELECT a.param_name, a.step, a.pp_rank AS pp_left, b.pp_rank AS pp_right, a.dp_rank, a.tp_rank, a.cksum AS cksum_left, b.cksum AS cksum_right FROM optimizer_states a JOIN optimizer_states b ON a.param_name = b.param_name AND a.step = b.step AND a.dp_rank = b.dp_rank AND a.tp_rank = b.tp_rank AND a.pp_rank = b.pp_rank - 1 WHERE a.pp_rank >= 0 AND b.pp_rank >= 0), inconsistency_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, pp_left, pp_right, dp_rank, tp_rank, cksum_left, cksum_right FROM boundary_pairs WHERE cksum_left != cksum_right) SELECT * FROM inconsistency_check ORDER BY step, param_name, pp_left

optimizer-step阶段pipeline分区边界optimizer状态数.name: optimizer-step阶段pipeline分区边界optimizer状态数值分布健康性检查

variants.sql: WITH optimizer_states AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') AS param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) AS pp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) AS dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) AS tp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') AS cksum, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'optimizer-step' AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) > 1 AND json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') IS NOT NULL), boundary_params AS (SELECT param_name, step, pp_rank, dp_rank, tp_rank, cksum FROM optimizer_states WHERE param_name LIKE '%optimizer_state%' OR param_name LIKE '%exp_avg%' OR param_name LIKE '%exp_avg_sq%' OR param_name LIKE '%learning_rate%' OR param_name LIKE '%beta%' OR param_name LIKE '%step%'), stats AS (SELECT param_name, step, pp_rank, dp_rank, tp_rank, cksum, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, dp_rank, tp_rank) AS pp_count, AVG(CAST(json_extract(data, '$.size') AS DOUBLE)) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, dp_rank, tp_rank) AS mean_size, STDDEV(CAST(json_extract(data, '$.size') AS DOUBLE)) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, dp_rank, tp_rank) AS std_size, MIN(CAST(json_extract(data, '$.size') AS DOUBLE)) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, dp_rank, tp_rank) AS min_size, MAX(CAST(json_extract(data, '$.size') AS DOUBLE)) OVER (PARTITION BY param_name, step, dp_rank, tp_rank) AS max_size FROM boundary_params JOIN coredump ON boundary_params.step = coredump.step AND boundary_params.param_name = json_extract_string(coredump.data, '$.name') AND boundary_params.pp_rank = CAST(json_extract(coredump.data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) AND boundary_params.dp_rank = CAST(json_extract(coredump.data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) AND boundary_params.tp_rank = CAST(json_extract(coredump.data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER)), anomaly_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, pp_rank, dp_rank, tp_rank, cksum, mean_size, std_size, min_size, max_size, pp_count, CASE WHEN std_size > 0 AND (max_size - 权重共享（weight tying）一致性检查（嵌入-输出）.name: 权重共享（weight tying）一致性检查（嵌入-输出）
权重共享（weight tying）一致性检查（嵌入-输出）.description: 对于 输入头（如 word_embeddings.weight） 与输出头（如 output_layer.weight）构成的权重共享对，在阶段model-after-optimizer-step中，同一（dp，tp）并行策略的cksum 应相等。

variants.sql: WITH weight_tying_pairs AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') AS param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) AS dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) AS tp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') AS cksum, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'model-after-optimizer-step' AND json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') IS NOT NULL AND (json_extract_string(data, '$.name') LIKE '%word_embeddings.weight%' OR json_extract_string(data, '$.name') LIKE '%output_layer.weight%')), paired_cksums AS (SELECT p1.param_name AS param1, p2.param_name AS param2, p1.dp_rank, p1.tp_rank, p1.step, p1.cksum AS cksum1, p2.cksum AS cksum2 FROM weight_tying_pairs p1 JOIN weight_tying_pairs p2 ON p1.dp_rank = p2.dp_rank AND p1.tp_rank = p2.tp_rank AND p1.step = p2.step AND p1.param_name LIKE '%word_embeddings.weight%' AND p2.param_name LIKE '%output_layer.weight%') SELECT param1, param2, dp_rank, tp_rank, step, cksum1, cksum2 FROM paired_cksums WHERE cksum1 != cksum2 ORDER BY step, dp_rank, tp_rank

WITH weight_tying_pairs AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') AS param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) AS dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) AS tp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') AS cksum, step FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'model-after-optimizer-step' AND json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') IS NOT NULL AND (json_extract_string(data, '$.name') LIKE '%word_embeddings.weight%' OR json_extract_string(data, '$.name') LIKE '%output_layer.weight%')), paired_checksums AS (SELECT p1.param_name AS embedding_name, p2.param_name AS output_name, p1.dp_rank, p1.tp_rank, p1.step, p1.cksum AS embedding_cksum, p2.cksum AS output_cksum FROM weight_tying_pairs p1 JOIN weight_tying_pairs p2 ON p1.dp_rank = p2.dp_rank AND p1.tp_rank = p2.tp_rank AND p1.step = p2.step AND p1.param_name LIKE '%word_embeddings.weight%' AND p2.param_name LIKE '%output_layer.weight%') SELECT embedding_name, output_name, dp_rank, tp_rank, step, embedding_cksum, output_cksum FROM paired_checksums WHERE embedding_cksum != output_cksum ORDER BY step, dp_rank, tp_rank

WITH weight_tying_pairs AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') AS param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) AS dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) AS tp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') AS cksum, step FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'model-after-optimizer-step' AND json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') IS NOT NULL AND (json_extract_string(data, '$.name') LIKE '%word_embeddings.weight%' OR json_extract_string(data, '$.name') LIKE '%output_layer.weight%')), pair_comparison AS (SELECT a.param_name AS embedding_name, b.param_name AS output_name, a.dp_rank, a.tp_rank, a.step, a.cksum AS embedding_cksum, b.cksum AS output_cksum FROM weight_tying_pairs a JOIN weight_tying_pairs b ON a.dp_rank = b.dp_rank AND a.tp_rank = b.tp_rank AND a.step = b.step AND a.param_name LIKE '%word_embeddings.weight%' AND b.param_name LIKE '%output_layer.weight%' AND a.cksum != b.cksum) SELECT * FROM pair_comparison ORDER BY step, dp_rank, tp_rank

模型初始化阶段TP参数分布一致性检查.name: 模型初始化阶段TP参数分布一致性检查
模型初始化阶段TP参数分布一致性检查.description: 在model initialization阶段，检查所有未被冻结（requires_grad=true）且未共享（shared=false）的参数，其初始数值分布（如均值、方差）在所有TP（张量并行）rank间必须保持一致。若发现分布不一致，表明初始化同步异常，可能导致训练不收敛或性能异常。

variants.sql: WITH param_stats AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) as tp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) as dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) as pp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') as cksum, step FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'initialization' AND json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') = true AND json_extract(data, '$.shared') = false AND json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') IS NOT NULL), inconsistency_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, COUNT(DISTINCT cksum) as distinct_cksums, COUNT(*) as total_records, array_agg(DISTINCT cksum) as all_cksums, array_agg(DISTINCT tp_rank) as tp_ranks FROM param_stats GROUP BY param_name, step HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cksum) > 1) SELECT * FROM inconsistency_check ORDER BY step, param_name

WITH param_stats AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) as tp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) as dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) as pp_rank, json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') as cksum, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'initialization' AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') AS BOOLEAN) = true AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.shared') AS BOOLEAN) = false AND CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) > 1 AND json_extract_string(data, '$.cksum') IS NOT NULL), inconsistency_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT cksum) as distinct_cksums, COUNT(*) as total_records, array_agg(DISTINCT cksum) as all_cksums, array_agg(DISTINCT tp_rank) as tp_ranks FROM param_stats GROUP BY param_name, step, dp_rank, pp_rank HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cksum) > 1) SELECT * FROM inconsistency_check ORDER BY step, param_name, dp_rank, pp_rank

模型完整性检查.name: 模型完整性检查
模型完整性检查.description: 检查model_integrity相关的所有约束，包括：梯度等的一致性检查。若任意子检查失败，则该检查失败。

variants.sql: WITH grad_stats AS (SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.name') AS param_name, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) AS dp_rank, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) AS tp_rank, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) AS pp_rank, JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.grad_cksum') AS grad_cksum, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.grad_cksum') IS NOT NULL AND stage LIKE '%backward%'), grad_inconsistency AS (SELECT param_name, step, stage, COUNT(DISTINCT grad_cksum) AS distinct_grad_cksums, COUNT(*) AS total_records, array_agg(DISTINCT grad_cksum) AS all_grad_cksums, array_agg(DISTINCT dp_rank) AS dp_ranks, array_agg(DISTINCT tp_rank) AS tp_ranks, array_agg(DISTINCT pp_rank) AS pp_ranks FROM grad_stats GROUP BY param_name, step, stage HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT grad_cksum) > 1) SELECT * FROM grad_inconsistency ORDER BY step, param_name

WITH grad_stats AS (SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.name') AS param_name, JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.grad_cksum') AS grad_cksum, step, JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.tp') AS tp, JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.dp') AS dp, JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.pp') AS pp FROM coredump WHERE stage = 'main-grad-in-backward' AND JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.grad_cksum') IS NOT NULL), inconsistency AS (SELECT param_name, step, COUNT(DISTINCT grad_cksum) AS distinct_grad_cksums, COUNT(*) AS total_records, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT grad_cksum) AS all_grad_cksums, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT tp) AS tp_ranks, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT dp) AS dp_ranks, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT pp) AS pp_ranks FROM grad_stats GROUP BY param_name, step HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT grad_cksum) > 1) SELECT * FROM inconsistency ORDER BY step, param_name

训练全程参数requires_grad属性不变性完整性检查.name: 训练全程参数requires_grad属性不变性完整性检查
训练全程参数requires_grad属性不变性完整性检查.description: 在所有训练阶段（forward/backward/optimizer-step），检查所有参数的requires_grad属性是否自初始化后保持不变。若发现参数的requires_grad属性在训练过程中发生变化，表明存在模型结构异常或外部干预，属于模型完整性异常。

variants.sql: WITH param_requires_grad AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') AS BOOLEAN) as requires_grad, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE json_extract_string(data, '$.name') IS NOT NULL), param_initial AS (SELECT param_name, requires_grad FROM param_requires_grad WHERE stage = 'model-after-optimizer-step' AND step = (SELECT MIN(step) FROM param_requires_grad WHERE stage = 'model-after-optimizer-step')), param_changes AS (SELECT p.param_name, p.step, p.stage, p.requires_grad as current_requires_grad, i.requires_grad as initial_requires_grad FROM param_requires_grad p JOIN param_initial i ON p.param_name = i.param_name WHERE p.requires_grad != i.requires_grad) SELECT param_name, step, stage, current_requires_grad, initial_requires_grad FROM param_changes ORDER BY param_name, step

WITH param_requires_grad AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') AS BOOLEAN) as requires_grad, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE json_extract_string(data, '$.name') IS NOT NULL), param_initial AS (SELECT param_name, requires_grad FROM param_requires_grad WHERE stage = 'model-after-optimizer-step' AND step = (SELECT MIN(step) FROM param_requires_grad WHERE stage = 'model-after-optimizer-step')), changed_params AS (SELECT p.param_name, p.step, p.stage, p.requires_grad as current_requires_grad, i.requires_grad as initial_requires_grad FROM param_requires_grad p JOIN param_initial i ON p.param_name = i.param_name WHERE p.requires_grad != i.requires_grad) SELECT param_name, step, stage, current_requires_grad, initial_requires_grad FROM changed_params ORDER BY param_name, step

WITH param_requires_grad AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') as requires_grad, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') IS NOT NULL), param_initial AS (SELECT param_name, requires_grad FROM param_requires_grad WHERE stage = 'model-after-optimizer-step' AND step = (SELECT MIN(step) FROM param_requires_grad WHERE stage = 'model-after-optimizer-step') GROUP BY param_name, requires_grad), param_changes AS (SELECT p.param_name, p.step, p.stage, p.requires_grad as current_requires_grad, i.requires_grad as initial_requires_grad FROM param_requires_grad p JOIN param_initial i ON p.param_name = i.param_name WHERE p.requires_grad != i.requires_grad) SELECT param_name, step, stage, current_requires_grad, initial_requires_grad FROM param_changes ORDER BY param_name, step

训练全程未分片参数requires_grad属性全局一致性完整性检查.name: 训练全程未分片参数requires_grad属性全局一致性完整性检查
训练全程未分片参数requires_grad属性全局一致性完整性检查.description: 在forward、backward、optimizer-step、checkpoint恢复等所有训练阶段，检查所有未分片参数（未被TP/PP/SP等并行策略分割的参数）的requires_grad属性是否与模型初始化时一致，且在所有并行组（DP/TP/PP/SP）之间完全一致。若属性漂移，参数将被错误地更新或冻结，导致训练发散或loss不下降。

variants.sql: WITH param_requires_grad AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') as requires_grad, step, stage, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) as tp, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) as pp, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) as dp FROM coredump WHERE json_extract(data, '$.tp') = 0 AND json_extract(data, '$.pp') = 0 AND json_extract(data, '$.dp') = 0), inconsistency_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, stage, COUNT(DISTINCT requires_grad) as distinct_requires_grad, COUNT(*) as total_records, array_agg(DISTINCT requires_grad) as all_requires_grad FROM param_requires_grad GROUP BY param_name, step, stage HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT requires_grad) > 1) SELECT * FROM inconsistency_check ORDER BY step, stage, param_name

WITH param_requires_grad AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') AS BOOLEAN) as requires_grad, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE stage IN ('forward', 'backward', 'optimizer-step', 'checkpoint') AND json_extract_string(data, '$.name') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') IS NOT NULL), inconsistency_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, stage, COUNT(DISTINCT requires_grad) as distinct_requires_grad, COUNT(*) as total_records, array_agg(DISTINCT requires_grad) as all_requires_grad FROM param_requires_grad GROUP BY param_name, step, stage HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT requires_grad) > 1) SELECT * FROM inconsistency_check ORDER BY step, stage, param_name

WITH param_stats AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.name') as param_name, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) as dp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.tp') AS INTEGER) as tp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.pp') AS INTEGER) as pp_rank, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.requires_grad') AS BOOLEAN) as requires_grad, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE json_extract(data, '$.tp') = 0 AND json_extract(data, '$.pp') = 0 AND json_extract(data, '$.dp') >= 0), inconsistency_check AS (SELECT param_name, step, stage, COUNT(DISTINCT requires_grad) as distinct_requires_grad, COUNT(*) as total_records, array_agg(DISTINCT requires_grad) as all_requires_grad, array_agg(DISTINCT dp_rank) as dp_ranks FROM param_stats GROUP BY param_name, step, stage HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT requires_grad) > 1) SELECT * FROM inconsistency_check ORDER BY step, stage, param_name

通用一致性检查.name: 通用一致性检查
通用一致性检查.description: 同一步、同一stage、同名参数在不同dp_rank上requires_grad应完全一致。用于发现某些rank未正确设置requires_grad导致的训练不一致问题。

variants.sql: SELECT step, stage, JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.name') AS param_name, JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.requires_grad') AS requires_grad, JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.grad_cksum') AS grad_cksum, JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.grad_shape') AS grad_shape, JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.grad_type') AS grad_type, JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.main_gr') AS main_gr FROM coredump WHERE JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.requires_grad') = false AND (JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.grad_cksum') IS NOT NULL OR JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.grad_shape') IS NOT NULL OR JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.grad_type') IS NOT NULL OR JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.main_gr') IS NOT NULL)

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.name') AS param_name, step, stage, COUNT(DISTINCT JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.requires_grad')) AS distinct_requires_grad, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.requires_grad')) AS requires_grad_values, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER)) AS dp_ranks FROM coredump WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.dp') AS INTEGER) > 0 AND JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.name') IS NOT NULL AND stage IS NOT NULL AND step IS NOT NULL GROUP BY param_name, step, stage HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.requires_grad')) > 1 ORDER BY step, stage, param_name

WITH param_info AS (SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.name') AS param_name, JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(data, '$.cksum') AS cksum, JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.dp') AS dp, JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.tp') AS tp, JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.pp') AS pp, step, stage FROM coredump WHERE JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.dp') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.tp') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_EXTRACT(data, '$.pp') IS NOT NULL), unsharded_params AS (SELECT param_name, step, stage, COUNT(DISTINCT cksum) AS distinct_cksums, COUNT(*) AS total_records, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT cksum) AS all_cksums FROM param_info WHERE dp = 0 AND tp = 0 AND pp = 0 GROUP BY param_name, step, stage HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cksum) > 1) SELECT * FROM unsharded_params ORDER BY step, stage, param_name
